name: HRS MOA
notes: Spesifikasyon "Reticle: HRS MOA" (adda birim MOA). 1.5-6x44: "Focal Plane: Second", "advanced illuminated grid reticle", Click Value 1/4 MOA. 1-6x24 HD: "Focal Plane: First", "first focal plane glass-etched HRS Grid Reticle with range estimation scaling", Click Value 1/2 MOA. family=hash "grid reticle" ifadesinden.
